checks.name: Legacy flight preference keys and 400x260 layout remain compatible
First staff switch uses 800x160 and keeps the old upper-left anchor
New session activates only after its own viewport is restored
Module selection is persisted
The long panel stays transparent and mouse click-through
Staff scaling uses the 5:1 ratio and logical 800-point width
Switching back restores flight's independent position and size
Returning to staff restores its independent position and size
Same or unknown module leaves its current geometry/session intact
Reopening remembers the selected module and its saved rectangle
Staff has a readable minimum width of 600 points
Staff maximum is screen-constrained and never exceeds 1600 points
Long-layout resizing keeps the upper-left anchor and accepts adjustment input
Finishing adjustment restores mouse transparency
Changing a hidden module does not activate rendering
Unknown saved identifiers fall back to flight
Both production modules are registered and staff has no palette panel
First redraw after native resume cannot display a cached old trajectory
Production drawing tilts the stem around an unchanged solid head
Retained native layers preserve the same pivot and rotating stem
Identical scene redraws have byte-identical pencil marks
Canvas remains mostly transparent with antialiased pencil lines
Graphite and pale underlines are visible on light and dark backgrounds
E2 and C7 note bodies, stems and flags remain inside the canvas
Minimum and maximum sizes render uniformly at 2x backing scale
